g.text: +allows(principal : Principal, access_level : str, office : str) : bool
One rule, three forms. A principal sees a document when
the document is public, or it is internal and the principal
is at least internal, or it is restricted and the principal
is restricted for that office (or for all offices).
The rule is applied inside the SQL query (BM25), inside the
Qdrant filter (dense) and again on the loaded rows.
Keys are compared by SHA-256 with a constant-time
comparison; query logs store only the pseudonym.
Pydantic models of the API contract
